sections.en: 6 λειπτικὴν ('ecliptic') A : ἐκλειπτικὴν ('ecliptic') in the margin written λειπτικὴν ('ecliptic') M : λειπτική ('ecliptic') for λειψιφωτοῦσα ('lacking light') seems to have been said. 7 ἐπιθεωρήσει ('will inspect') the codices have. 8 διαμετροῦσιν ('they are diametrically opposed') A. 10 παρέχων ('providing') the codices have. 11 ἐπιλύσεως ('of release') the codices have : ὑποχύσεως ('of cataract') corrected from Ptolemy. ποιοῦσιν ('they make') the codices have; corrected by Kroll. 13 Ἡλίου σχηματισθεὶς ('configured of the Sun') the codices have; corrected from Ptolemy. τὸν ('the') M : τῶν ('of the') A. 17 μέλων ('of limbs') thus with three dots A. 18 ἀμαυρῶν ('dim') A : ἀφανῶν ('invisible') M. 19 ἐξαιρέτ(ως) ('exceptionally') the codices have; corrected; compare above p. 206, 11 and Ptolemy, p. 148, 20 : παρατηρέσεως ἔτυχον ἐξαιρέτου ('they obtained exceptional observation'). ἐφ’ ᾧ ('on which') the codices have; corrected. 23 μοιρῶν ('of degrees') M. 25 ἥ ἐστι ... αὐτοῦ ('which is ... of him') omitted by A. 26 τοῦ ('of the') we have bracketed. τὰς ιη΄ μοίρας ('the 18 degrees') A. 28 πλεκάμων ('of braids') A. 29 κζ΄ ('27') supplied. Missing is μέτωπον Σκορπίου ('forehead of Scorpio') which is found in Exc. Paris. περὶ ('about') omitted by A. κάλπίος ('of a pitcher') M.

sections.en:
1 These are excerpted almost word for word from the chapter of the Tetrabiblos Concerning injuries and diseases, p. 149, 14 ff., edit. of the year 1553.
2 The ancient Egyptians were afflicted with inflammations of the eyes just as their descendants are now, and the result of this was that the Alexandrian astrologers often discussed diseases of the eyes.

summary.headline: Injury-Causing Degrees
summary.text: Chapter 137 discusses injury-causing degrees and astrological configurations that damage vision, especially malefic planets afflicting the Sun or Moon. It lists harmful stellar regions in Cancer, Taurus, Sagittarius, Scorpio, Leo, and Virgo, including the Pleiades, the little cloud of Cancer, and Sagittarius’s eye.
